observation: Mock-everything test pyramid violated AH track HARD rule (no mocked credential routes). Phase 2 architecture critique flagged missing CC-007 EnvCredentialResolver eval caller; plan enumerated 17 fixtures. Phase 3 green: all unit/integration tests passed. Phase 4 review discovered AC1/AC5 unproven: Playwright proof ran Vite-only (port 5179) with page.route() mocks on credential endpoints, ECONNREFUSED real backend + mocked responses. AH track requires real backend for all ACs; proof was structurally broken despite green unit/integration. Root cause: red-phase test setup mocked the wrong boundary. Required Phase 4 fix: dedicated ah1-real-backend Playwright project (real Hono + PGlite, non-3001 port) with no page.route on credential paths.

Tautological invariant test (single-resolver contract) was written to pass against the broken wiring. Spec: 'assert exactly one DbCredentialResolver.' Red-phase test asserted instanceof DbCredentialResolver after the fix was applied — but the test was not independently red against the pre-fix state (EnvCredentialResolver). Test passed on green because code changed; it would not have caught a developer manually breaking the resolver back to EnvCredentialResolver. Phase 4 fix: test rewritten to genuinely red against old wiring (proves the fix was necessary, not just cosmetic).

Architecture critique (Phase 2) caught 3 CRITICALs before code: CC-007 (EnvCredentialResolver deletion), CRITICAL-2 (fail-loud fixture isolation), CRITICAL-3 (validate endpoint `never` guard + missing openai-compatible case). All three were resolved in Phase 3 green phase without rework. Critique's plan reconciliation table (spec vs live code, line numbers) and cited grep results anchored the findings — high signal, no false positives. Critique score 7/10 despite blockers because root causes were concrete and fixable.

Phase 4 review finding W1 (reviewer hallucination): flagged 'missing architecture.md' when the file was tracked at plans/AH1/architecture.md. Reviewer expected it in docs/architecture/ and did not verify its actual location. Reviewer read cold (correct policy) but did not trace the file reference before reporting. One false finding cost credibility despite the two genuine CRITICAL findings being correct.

Architecture critique caught process gate: CC-007 eval-lane coupling was called out as CRITICAL-1. Plan explicitly decided Alt (a) — retain EnvCredentialResolver for eval only, scope single-resolver to server-factory. Decision was documented with Alt (b) rationale (why NOT eval→throwaway pglite). This preempted a post-code 'should we delete eval's import' discovery. Critique's explicit decision documentation pattern prevented rework.

Timeline: ~6 working days (concurrent branch). Phase 1 (concept locked upstream): scaffolding + red tests ~6h. Phase 2 (architecture critique + design critique): 8.5/10, 1 designer revision round (2h fix-to-resubmit). Phase 3 (green): ~16h large L full-stack session (all tasks 7-20, SQL migrations, route rewiring, Playwright harness standing up, tests). Phase 4 review round 1: 2 CRITICALs found (Vite-only mocking, tautological test). Phase 4 fix: ~4h standing up real-backend Playwright project + invariant test rewrite. Total productive: ~30h. Infrastructure/rework: ~4h. Process cost: architecture critique + 1 design revision + 1 review round + 1 fix round.

Builder committed .verify-attestation.json prematurely (Task 3 attestation, committed in feat commit 3d06072d before Phase 4 review). /ship skill owns attestation lifecycle. Minor process deviation: attestation created during build, committed, then review happened. This is fine if review does not produce code changes; Phase 4 had 2 CRITICALs that required a fix commit (3f274623). Attestation file should have been created/signed AFTER Phase 4 verify, not during Phase 3. No blocking issue but signals attestation-timing awareness.

Pattern match: CC-007 (scope-not-enumerated) recurring. AH1 Phase 2 critic caught undefined eval-lane consumers of EnvCredentialResolver because the plan reconciliation section enumerated call sites (grep results). AH2 (downstream) inherited the lesson: when a symbol is deleted, enumerate ALL consumers upfront — do not assume 'probably just server'. This discipline prevents 'oops npm run check fails on packages/eval' at green phase.
